title: Laboratory Handling Equipment
description: Premium borosilicate glass laboratory glassware — beakers, flasks, volumetric glassware, crucibles, and distillation apparatus for analytical and research laboratories in Oman.

details.longDescription: Laboratory Equipment and Glassware supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC supplies a comprehensive range of laboratory handling equipment and borosilicate glass apparatus to quality control laboratories, research facilities, university laboratories, food testing labs, water analysis laboratories, and industrial QC departments across Muscat and Oman. Our laboratory glassware portfolio includes beakers (Griffin, Berzelius patterns — 50ml to 5,000ml), Erlenmeyer (conical) flasks (25ml to 5,000ml), volumetric flasks (Class A and Class B — 25ml to 2,000ml), graduated cylinders (10ml to 2,000ml), burettes (25ml and 50ml, Class A), pipettes (graduated and volumetric, various sizes), separating funnels (pear-shaped and cylindrical), round-bottom and flat-bottom flasks (100ml to 20L), distillation apparatus and reflux condensers, Kjeldahl flasks for nitrogen analysis, crucibles and evaporating dishes, watch glasses, petri dishes, and sample containers. All glassware is manufactured from Type I borosilicate glass 3.3 (high chemical resistance, low thermal expansion). ISO and ASTM volumetric standards available. Also supplying laboratory consumables including filter papers, tubing, stoppers, clamps, and stands. Delivery across Oman; supply to UAE, Saudi Arabia, and GCC on request.
applications: Analytical chemistry titrations and volumetric analysis
